label: Finding-68
title: fi-offline: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: Two start times in the same sources: Helsinki Times gives 12:45 for restricting traffic but also says Naumanen told STT "the shutdown process had begun shortly after 1 pm"; Yle says the same. The timeline row (09:45Z, confidence "inferred") should note that 12:45 is the restriction start per Helsinki Times only. | Yle and Helsinki Times are not fully independent: Yle's piece is bylined "Yle News / STT" and Helsinki Times also relies on STT for Naumanen; only Helsinki Times carries 12:45. The Valtori site capture (fi-valtori) failed ("Target page, context or browser has been closed"), so there is no operator capture.
